songs.note: Vol. 3: (The Subliminal Verses) was tracked in Drop B. Many tabs are written in E standard for convenience — the record is not.
Open E with a capo at fret 3 (sounds as open G). Played with a slide/bottleneck.
Original recording is a whole step down, D standard. No capo.
Page's signature DADGAD drone. The riff relies on the open D/A strings ringing.
Drop D. The main riff is built on the dropped 6th string.
Open G on FIVE strings: Keith removes the low 6th entirely. On a normal six-string, tune to open G and simply ignore the 6th string. Intentionally not identical to the six-string open-g entry.
Standard tuning — no retune needed.
Hendrix almost always tuned a half step down.
Drop C. Verify by ear against the record — SOAD used several low tunings across albums.
Drop B. Same Vol. 3 sessions as Vermilion Pt. 2.
Drop B. Tabs are often written in E standard for convenience; the record is not. Inferred from the album's usual tuning; not individually verified.
Drop A, not Drop B. Slipknot drop below their usual Drop B for this one. Transposed Drop B arrangements of it exist, but the record is Drop A.

D standard. Tabber writes 'Tune guitar to D:'. Conflict flag: different album uses Drop Bb.

Drop Bb (Drop A#) — lowest string dropped from C standard. Tab labels strings from low to high: Bb F Bb Eb G C. Tabber calls it 'Dropped Bflat (or A#)'. Different from D standard used on Viva Emptiness — Katatonia shifted significantly lower by 2006.
D standard per tab ('Tune down to D'). Conflict: 'Monochromatic Stains' from the same album is tabbed in C# standard — one of these tabbers may have been wrong. Treat with caution.
C# standard. Tab spells out all six strings: 'C# F# B E G# C#'. Conflict: 'Damage Done' title track from same album is tabbed in D standard.
C# standard. Tab states 'Down 1 1/2 step (Db Gb B E Ab Db)'. Consistent with C# standard across the album.

Drop B. Tab explicitly labels all six strings from high to low: C# G# E B F# B. Reversed = B F# B E G# C# from low to high = Drop B (C# standard with lowest string dropped 2 semitones). Album not stated in tab; attributed from general knowledge.
C# standard. Guitar Pro tab shows all three guitar tracks: 'Gtr I (Db Gb B E Ab Db)'. Db=C#, Gb=F#, Ab=G# — standard enharmonic equivalents.

Non-standard open C#-based tuning. GP tab header: 'Gtr I (C# G# C# F# A# C#)'. From low to high: C#2 G#2 C#3 F#3 A#3 C#4 — strings 2-5 are 2 semitones above C# standard, outer strings stay at C#. Conflict flag: Enslaved used C# standard on Ruun (2006). This open tuning may be transcription-specific.
